dse_runs.notes: Spec: low_area_control. Area is everything: minimize LUTs+FFs while meeting throughput >= 1 MSPS and max_abs_err <= 2^-10. Favor compact iterative/pipelined CORDIC with enough iterations for 10-bit accuracy; keep data width modest.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **low_area_control** was finalized with the selection `iterative:data_width=16, n_iter=12, angle_guard=0, frac_guard=1, rounding=trunc` — 267 LUTs+FFs (169 LUTs, 98 FFs), 10.5 accuracy bits (max_abs_err 2^-10.46, comfortably under the 2^-10 requirement), and 13.2 MSPS throughput (well above the 1 MSPS constraint). L1 used the full 400-evaluation budget via the structured DSE graph, which mapped a 34-design feasible Pareto front dominated by compact iterative CORDIC variants. L2 system simulation confirmed the design's DDS context (SFDR 79.9 dBc, SNR 70.6 dB, 15-cycle latency) with no selection change. L3/L4/L5 found no recorded verification or synthesis data for this design class (back_annotate returned no_measured_data, no winner change flagged), so the L1-estimated selection stands as final.
